about: Mutants of compiler/check/load, the import loader and interface pass typedump, exprdump and inferdump share (S3d12). The types agreement (TestCompilerTypesAgreeWithChecker) kills each: every one makes an Ergo import's types resolve otherwise than the Go checker's.

mutants.name: deps-read-empty
mutants.rule: An import the program holds reads its computed interface, not an empty one (S3d12).

mutants.name: prelude-not-given
mutants.origin: wf10 capstone S3d3; moved to compiler/check/load with the loader (SELFHOST-B25)
mutants.rule: The prelude's Append, Get, Put and Delete are functions on every package's slices and Maps.

mutants.name: deps-not-given
mutants.origin: wf10 capstone S3d3; moved to compiler/check/load with the loader (SELFHOST-B25)
mutants.rule: Each package is typed with its imports' loaded packages, so its imports' members are typed.

mutants.name: deps-own-path-kept
mutants.origin: wf10 capstone S3d3; moved to compiler/check/load with the loader (SELFHOST-B25)
mutants.rule: A package's own types are named by the path its tables give (main for a checked root), which orders a row's elements as the Go checker does.

mutants.name: iface-named-main
mutants.origin: wf10 capstone S3d12; moved to compiler/check/load with the loader (SELFHOST-B25)
mutants.rule: A package's interface is named by its import path, which its importers print its types with, not a checked root's main (S3d12).

mutants.name: stream-plan-cycle-ignored
mutants.from: Plan{Waves: waves, Last: last, Whole: left > 0}
mutants.to: Plan{Waves: waves, Last: last, Whole: false}
mutants.rule: PlanOf must report Whole=true when a read cycle leaves unplaced packages so callers fall back to whole-program checking.

mutants.name: stream-last-retained-past-reader
mutants.rule: Last[j] must be the maximum reader wave, not the last reader in slice order, or an Art is dropped before later-wave importers read it.
